purpose: MEASUREMENT SET v2: harder by construction after v1 saturated (hidden_pass 0.95-1.00 in every arm on Sonnet 5.5, reports/2026-10-02)
selection_rule: hand-written 2026-10-02 before any v2 run: each case is a precise multi-clause spec (5-10 clauses) with sparse visible tests, so an agent that does not check its work against the spec misses clauses. Every hidden assertion follows from the written spec. Spans parsing/validation (d01 d04 d09 d15 d17 d18), algorithms (d02 d03 d06 d08 d10), security-relevant (d05 escaping, d12 path traversal, d20 password policy), state/consistency (d07 d11 d19), money (d03 d13), shell (d14), refactor (d16). Never selected, edited or dropped by observed model performance; built because v1 SATURATED, a property of the instrument.
